title: llama-swap on bare metal with the measured roster
description: Install llama-swap, point per-model cmd at ~/.local/opt/llama.cpp-vulkan/llama-b10502/llama-server. Roles: fast+vision -> Qwen3.6-35B-A3B bartowski Q4_K_M; deep+vision -> Qwen3.5-122B-A10B lmstudio Q4_K_M. Bind so test containers reach it and the LAN does not. TTL unloading so roles that do not fit together do not have to.

title: Write the five isolation tests
description: tests/09-isolation.bats — no host bind mount declared; host home invisible; contract refuses the LAN; egress limited to the contract; work volume readable by a second container.
acceptance_criteria: all five red when written, then green
close_reason: 5 isolation tests green; contract bound 127.0.0.1 only, reached via unix socket; no firewall, no root

title: Harness base: rootless podman image and volume conventions
description: Agent containers: no host bind mounts, workspaces on named volumes, egress restricted to the contract host and port. Verified preconditions: host.containers.internal reachable, /home empty in a stock container.
acceptance_criteria: a harness container starts, writes to a named volume, and cannot list host home
close_reason: suite-net --internal + contract-proxy on both networks. Verified: proxy 200, internet 000, host-direct 000, /home empty

title: Test scaffolding: bats, Makefile, make test
description: npm i -g bats (1.13.0, user-level, no root). jq already at /usr/bin/jq. Makefile target 'test' runs tests/*.bats. No tests yet — this is the runner only.
acceptance_criteria: make test runs and reports zero tests without erroring
close_reason: make test runs, reports 0 tests, exits 0; make setup verifies bats 1.13.0 / jq 1.8.1 / podman 5.7.0

title: CUJ-01: coding task at the terminal on a local model
description:
Stand up llama-swap on bare metal with the measured roster, then reach it from a containerised opencode. Delivered form is native opencode on Nathan's session; the test uses a container.

Roster measured on this box (see .necklace/2026-08-19-local-claude-suite/repl/results.md):
- fast/vision: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B bartowski Q4_K_M, 20.74 GiB, 811 pp512 / 59.6 tg128
- deep/vision: Qwen3.5-122B-A10B lmstudio Q4_K_M, 69.10 GiB, 215 pp512 / 26.4 tg128

Tests that close it:
- contract answers both API shapes on one port
- opencode reaches the contract and completes one tool call
acceptance_criteria: tests/01-terminal.bats: both tests green, each red when written
close_reason: CUJ-01 both tests green: contract answers both API shapes; opencode in the jail completed a tool call

title: CUJ-09: isolation boundary — nothing under evaluation reaches Nathan's files
description:
Build the rootless-podman test harness and prove the boundary holds. Foundational: CUJ-01's containerised test needs this harness to exist. Tested to destruction because every failure mode here is silent.

Tests that close it:
- no agent container declares a host bind mount
- an agent container cannot see the host home
- the contract is not reachable from the LAN
- an agent container reaches nothing but the contract
- a work volume outlives its container and is readable by another
acceptance_criteria: tests/09-isolation.bats: all five tests green, each red when written
close_reason: 5 isolation tests green; contract bound 127.0.0.1 only, reached via unix socket; no firewall, no root
